services.meta.title: ILogic Services | Websites, Systems, Automation & Security
services.meta.description: Websites, online stores, SEO, business systems, automation and security. Digital solutions for businesses across Egypt and the Middle East.
services.breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
services.hero.title: Start with what you need.
services.hero.text: You may need a website that reaches new customers, a store that makes buying easier, or a system that takes work off your team's hands. We understand how you work, then design, develop and secure the right solution.
services.hero.visual: An illustration of digital solutions connecting communication, orders and tasks in one workflow
services.hero.caption: A clearer presence. Simpler work. Time for what matters.
services.scene.eyebrow: From your needs to your solution
services.catalog.title: Choose what your business needs now
services.catalog.text: You do not have to build everything at once. We start where it can make a difference to your business and leave room to develop from there.
services.web.title: Websites
services.web.question: Introduce your business and earn your customer's trust
services.web.text: We turn your services and work into a clear, easy-to-use website that helps visitors understand what you offer and take the next step.
services.store.title: Online stores
services.store.question: From finding a product to completing an order
services.store.text: We build an organized shopping experience with clear products and straightforward ordering. Payment and delivery integrations are chosen around your project.
services.seo.title: Search visibility
services.seo.question: Be found by people looking for your service
services.seo.text: We prepare your website's structure and content for search, with pages that answer customer questions and help them get to know you before reaching out.
services.systems.title: Business systems
services.systems.question: Connected information instead of scattered follow-ups
services.systems.text: We develop ERP, CRM and custom systems to organize operations, customers and data around the roles and workflows your business actually needs.
services.automation.title: Process automation
services.automation.question: Give repetitive work a clear path
services.automation.text: We connect tools and workflows to reduce duplicate entry and manual follow-ups, giving your team time for work that needs their expertise.
services.security.title: Website & system security
services.security.question: Protect your website and software from content that harms your reputation
services.security.text: Before handover, we check your website or system for vulnerabilities and address them. We review access permissions, updates and security settings to reduce the risk of intrusion, data leaks and injected content that could harm your company's reputation.
services.sectors.title: The same logic. Different needs in every field.
services.sectors.text: We work across sectors in Egypt and the Middle East. Choose your field to explore the kind of solution that could help.
services.sectors.other: Do not see your field? Tell us what you need and we will explore how we can help.
services.projects.title: Building tools for business owners' peace of mind
services.projects.text: Alongside client projects, we are developing a system that eases administrative work and gives business owners more space to think and grow.
services.projects.business.title: Business management platform
services.projects.business.text: A system that connects management tasks and reduces repetitive responsibilities. We start with small businesses' needs and develop it to extend to larger organizations.
services.projects.business.focus: Organized work · Connected data · Clearer follow-ups
services.projects.teams.title: Team management and task automation
services.projects.teams.text: As part of our vision for the platform, we are working toward simpler roles and task follow-ups, with less work lost between messages and manual checks.
services.projects.teams.focus: Clear roles · Connected tasks · Time for what matters
services.projects.note: We will share details when they are ready to show. The work described here is not a product available to purchase today.
services.safety.eyebrow: Security is part of the solution
services.safety.title: Your website is part of your reputation
services.safety.lead: What if your customer found content you never published? An attack can harm more than a website; it can damage trust in your company. That is why security informs how we build and operate a solution.
services.safety.reputation.title: Protect customer trust
services.safety.reputation.text: We review weaknesses that could allow injected links or inappropriate content and address their causes.
services.safety.data.title: Access according to need
services.safety.data.text: We configure roles and permissions to reduce unauthorized access to business and customer data.
services.safety.continuity.title: Care after launch
services.safety.continuity.text: We define suitable updates, backups and follow-ups for the website or system within an agreed scope.
services.safety.note: The assessment and protection measures depend on your project and the risks it faces.
services.cta.title: Tell us what takes up your time. We can start there.
services.cta.text: You do not need to know the name of a system or technology. Tell us how you work and what you want to improve, and we will help you find a useful starting point.
